name: mastermind like domain containing 1
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: MAMLD1 encodes mastermind-like domain-containing protein 1. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and male gonad development.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to hypospadias 2, X-linked (x-linked).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Ependymoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
